subject: Investigative log snapshot request — FinLytics incident
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@finlytics.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Incident: need short-term access to logs for payment failure triage

Hi Logan / Monica,

We just saw a spike of failed payments for several customers starting ~08:45 PT. Our ops team captured some traces but we need a short window where Redwood can preserve relevant inference logs and request metadata so we can correlate tokens and confirm whether routing or model selection caused the failures.

Can you preserve the slice for the timeframe 2028-10-12 08:30:00 — 2028-10-12 09:30:00 (UTC-7) while we triage? We only need the request/response payloads, routing headers, and the model variant IDs. Target window is ~72 hours but we can be flexible if policy restricts that. Attaching a screenshot of the error cluster and a brief list of artifacts we think are required.

Attachments: finlytics-incident-1.png, requested-artifacts-list.pdf

Thanks,
Alicia Ramos
Head of Engineering
FinLytics

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 09:34:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident: need short-term access to logs for payment failure triage

Monica — looping you in for a short-term preserve. Customer is asking for 72 hours but we should follow the minimum necessary principle.

Quick context: FinLytics is mid-market, high-volume payments workload. They reported a production spike with potential PCI touchpoints; they asked for request/response payloads + routing headers + model variant ids for the one-hour window.

Proposed immediate action:
- Create a timeboxed snapshot (slice id: FINLY-20281012-01) for the one-hour window.
- Apply retention override for 48 hours by default; escalate to Compliance for anything longer.
- Export must be encrypted and access-granted only to named FinLytics ops and our triage group.

Requesting:
- Monica: assign ops owner and create snapshot, include exact artifact list and storage path.
- Vivek: help with customer comms and confirm who at FinLytics should sign the data-preserve consent form.

If Compliance requires, we will reduce to 24 hours or require DocuSign approval.

Thanks,
Logan
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 09:47:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident: need short-term access to logs for payment failure triage

Got it. I'll stand up the snapshot and inventory the exact artifacts. Quick questions before I proceed:
- Do we have explicit customer consent recorded for a 72-hour hold, or should I ask them to sign a one-click consent?
- Is PCI-scope data expected in the payloads? If so, Security will want the minimum redaction applied prior to any internal consumption.

I'll prepare the storage location + presigned access and will mark the snapshot as encrypted with a customer-specific KMS key. Planning to tag with FINLY-20281012-01 and lock deletion for 48 hours pending Compliance signoff.

—Monica
Senior Support Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Oct 2028 10:12:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident: need short-term access to logs for payment failure triage

On Sun, Oct 14, 2028 at 09:03 AM Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Monica — looping you in for a short-term preserve. Customer is asking for 72 hours but we should follow the minimum necessary principle.

Thanks for the heads-up. Security/Compliance reviewed the request and will approve a limited, auditable preserve under these conditions: 
1) Timebox to 48 hours maximum without an executed customer Data Preserve Addendum.
2) Snapshot must be stored in a segregated path with object tags: "finlytics:incident=20281012", "preserve:authorized_by=E.Hart".
3) Access limited to: monica_patel, logan_wright, vivek_kulkarni, plus the two FinLytics ops emails provided. No other internal read access.
4) Any PCI-related fields must be redacted at rest; if redaction prevents triage, escalate to Legal for a temporary carveout.
5) All actions must be logged in JIRA SEC-7842 and we need a signed DocuSign approval from FinLytics before we extend beyond 48 hours.

If you want, I can pre-fill the DocuSign and approve the 48-hour window now so Monica can proceed.

—Evelyn Hart
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@finlytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Oct 2028 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident: need short-term access to logs for payment failure triage

Alicia — quick update on status and next steps.

We have created a timeboxed snapshot (slice id: FINLY-20281012-01) covering 2028-10-12 08:30 — 09:30 PT and applied a 48-hour preserve per Compliance. Snapshot location (internal): s3://redwood-preserves/finlytics/FINLY-20281012-01 (encrypted, customer-KMS).

Actions taken:
- Preserved artifacts: request/response payloads, routing headers, model_variant_id, inference-timing-metrics.
- Redaction: PCI PAN fields are redacted at rest; if you need the raw fields for triage, please sign the DocuSign I just sent (link below) and we'll follow the Legal carveout process.
- Access: granted to Alicia Ramos and ops@finlytics.com, plus Monica, Vivek, and myself. We will not open access to other internal teams.
- Retention: automatic deletion scheduled for 48 hours from creation (2028-10-16 16:22 PT) unless we receive a signed Addendum for a longer hold.

DocuSign link (customer approval if you need >48h or raw PCI fields): https://docusign.com/finlytics-log-preserve-approval
JIRA ticket: SEC-7842

Let me know if this meets the needs for triage. If you confirm the preserve is sufficient, we will share a secure presigned URL for download of the artifacts.

Thanks for flagging this quickly — we will keep you posted on findings.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
